Laying your instant lawn

Four simple steps to a lawn you can enjoy straight away.

1

Prepare the ground

Clear weeds and stones, level the soil and rake it fine.

2

Lay the turf

Lay rolls tight in a brick pattern, staggering the joints.

3

Roll and trim

Press the turf down so it meets the soil and cut edges to fit.

4

Water well

Keep it moist, with regular watering for the first weeks.
